grade_ledger.basis: exact: void carries no mass, so aggregate density is the packing fraction times the unit density; mass/volume conservation. Deterministic, bit-for-bit.

grade_ledger.basis: exact: the VP master relation c^2=B/rho applied at both levels gives c'/c = sqrt(B'/B * rho/rho') = sqrt(phi*J / phi) = sqrt(J). Deterministic closed form.
grade_ledger.channel: wave-speed softening ratio per rung  c'/c = sqrt(J(phi))

grade_ledger.basis: exact: climbing two rungs equals one combined rung to < 1e-9 (semigroup property); the ladder is a consistent RG flow.
exact RG theorem of the idealized ladder: J<1 for every phi<1, so c strictly decreases each rung. Holds for any phi<1 with no ECM stiffening; that proviso is stated.
